# rapttor/yii2-legal

> Yii2 package for multilingual legal pages, consents and privacy requests, from one company config, in 17 languages with a language switcher: terms, privacy, cookies, imprint, refunds, DPA, game rules, app terms, licence. Also one-checkbox-per-item consents with proof, cookie consent, email stop and block, a privacy request form, and country restrictions per app activity. Texts come from rapttor/legal, bundled by Composer, no runtime network access.

Integrating or changing this package: read AGENTS.md first. It lists what to ask the owner, what never to invent, and the promises the legal texts make that the app must keep.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): integration steps, rules, promises checklist, how to change the package
- [README.md](README.md): install, configuration, languages, console commands, safety
- [src/Legal.php](src/Legal.php): the application component (documents(), html(), markdown(), url(), offered(), languageList(), release(), missing())
- [src/widgets/LegalLinks.php](src/widgets/LegalLinks.php) and [src/widgets/LanguageSwitcher.php](src/widgets/LanguageSwitcher.php): footer links and language switcher
- Consents on by default for every app: documents, age and legal-age confirmation, upload responsibility; opt-in: gambling and custom `consents` items
- [src/Consents.php](src/Consents.php), [src/External.php](src/External.php), [src/Email.php](src/Email.php), [src/Withdrawal.php](src/Withdrawal.php): consents checklist, third-party resources, stopping email, withdrawal function
- [src/blocklist/](src/blocklist/): blocklist adapters (Postar needs the endpoint from its docs)
- [src/controllers/LegalController.php](src/controllers/LegalController.php): pages, hreflang, fallback notice
- [tests/LegalTest.php](tests/LegalTest.php): behaviour covered (sanitising, fallback to last good render, languages, routes)
- Upstream texts and rules: https://github.com/rapttor/rapttor.legal (AGENTS.md, SPEC.md)
- Activity tags (`policy.activities`: gambling, alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, adult, dating, lgbtq, crypto, vpn, weapons, pharmacy, sanctions) add the countries that prohibit them to a required visitor checkbox; `php yii legal/restrictions [tag]` lists the data (sources and confidence per country)
- Privacy and legal requests: `/legal/request`, `Yii::$app->legal->requests()`, `Legal::EVENT_REQUEST` to alert admins; no reply times on pages
- Consents are stored through https://github.com/rapttor/yii2-metadata (`Yii::$app->metadata`, row `key=legal`, `remote_table=profile`): history, `export()` for access requests, `deleteAll()` on account deletion
- New-account sign-in: `ConsentChecklist` widget and `consents()->missingRequired()`; the title is `appName()`; every consent is its own unticked checkbox with a short title and small-print hint; `LanguageSwitcher::widget(['sameRoute' => true])` above the form
- Languages: English, Balkan `sh` (aliases sr, hr, bs, cnr, sr-Cyrl), de, fr, es, pt-BR, it, pl, nl, tr, uk, ru, ar, hi, ja, ko, zh-Hans (drafts); Balkan wording rules in rapttor/legal `i18n/BRIEF-sh.md`
- Your own superadmins skip the consent gate (`exceptCan`); tenant admins consent like everybody else
